app_info.subtitle: Generate images, videos & PDFs
app_info.description:
Templated is an API and drag-and-drop editor for generating images, videos and PDFs from reusable templates. Design a template once (or import it from Canva), then let ChatGPT render it with new text, images and colors on demand.

With this app ChatGPT can:
- Render images (PNG, JPG, WebP), multi-page PDFs and MP4 videos from any of your templates by changing layer values
- Browse, search and inspect your templates, layers and pages to know what can be customized
- Create, update, clone and organize templates and folders
- Upload images and fonts from URLs and manage your assets
- Merge PDF renders and check your account usage

Renders are produced by Templated's rendering engine from templates you designed, so the output is consistent, on-brand and ready to use in marketing, e-commerce, social media, documents and automations. Sign in with your Templated account when connecting.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new render (image, PDF or video) in the user's Templated account, so it writes a new record and a new output file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Layer values may include image URLs that Templated fetches from the open web to compose the output, so the tool can reach hosts outside Templated.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new render; the template and any existing renders are left untouched.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches the status and file URL of one render already stored in the account and writes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a single record from the user's own Templated account and contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Viewing a render changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists renders already stored in the account, paginated, without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries only the user's own account data inside Templated.
justifications.destructive_justification: Listing renders does not alter or remove any of them.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a render record and its output file from the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts on one record inside the user's own Templated account and reaches no third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: The render and its file are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

justifications.read_only_justification: Produces a new combined PDF from existing PDF renders, so it creates a new file and record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Works only with renders already stored in the user's account; no external URL is fetched.
justifications.destructive_justification: The source renders are kept as they are; only a new merged PDF is added.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists and searches the templates in the account without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the user's own template list inside Templated and contacts no external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Listing templates changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the details (name, size, thumbnail) of one template and writes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a single template record from the user's own account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Viewing a template leaves it untouched.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the layers of a template so the model knows what can be customized; nothing is written.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads template data stored in the user's own account only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Inspecting layers does not modify the template.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the pages and layers of a multi-page template without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads template data stored in the user's own account only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Inspecting pages does not modify the template.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new template with the layers or pages provided, so it writes a new record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Image layers may reference URLs that Templated fetches from the open web when the template is built or rendered.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new template; existing templates are not changed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Modifies an existing template's name, size, layers or pages.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updated image layers may reference URLs that Templated fetches from the open web.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the template's previous layers or pages, and a page marked hidden is removed, so earlier content is lost.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a copy of an existing template, which is a new record in the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Copies data already stored in the user's account; no external system is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: The original template is not modified; only a copy is added.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a template from the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts on one record inside the user's own account and reaches no third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: The template is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the renders previously generated from one template without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the user's own render history inside Templated only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Listing renders does not alter or remove any of them.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the folders used to organize templates and writes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the user's own account data only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Listing folders changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new, empty folder in the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes a record inside the user's own account; no external system is involved.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adding a folder does not affect existing folders or templates.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renames an existing folder.
justifications.open_world_justification: Modifies one record inside the user's own account only.
justifications.destructive_justification: The previous folder name is overwritten.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a folder from the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts on one record inside the user's own account and reaches no third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: The folder is permanently deleted.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the images previously uploaded to the account without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the user's own asset list inside Templated only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Listing uploads changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a new image in the account's asset library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Templated downloads the file from the URL the user provides, which can be any host on the open web.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new asset; existing uploads are not changed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes an uploaded image from the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts on one record inside the user's own account and reaches no third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: The uploaded file is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the custom fonts in the account without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the user's own font list inside Templated only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Listing fonts changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a new custom font in the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Templated downloads the font file from the URL the user provides, which can be any host on the open web.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new font; existing fonts are not changed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a custom font from the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts on one record inside the user's own account and reaches no third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: The font is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the connected account's render usage for the current period and writes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the user's own account record inside Templated only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Viewing usage changes nothing.

test_cases.description: Browse the templates in the connected account.
test_cases.expected_output: A list of the account's templates with name, size (width x height) and a thumbnail link for each.

test_cases.description: Inspect a template to learn what can be customized.
test_cases.user_prompt: What can I customize in my first template?
test_cases.expected_output: The layers of the template (name and type for each, such as text or image) with their current values, explained as what can be changed in a render.

test_cases.description: Render an image from a template with new text.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an image from my first template and change the main title text to 'Summer Sale'.
test_cases.expected_output: A completed render with a link to the generated image (JPG by default) showing the template with the title replaced by 'Summer Sale'.

test_cases.description: Render a PDF from a template.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a PDF from my first template with the title 'Jane Doe'.
test_cases.expected_output: A completed render with a link to the generated PDF file.

test_cases.description: Create a new template from scratch.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new 1080x1080 template called 'Quote card' with a dark background and a white text layer named 'quote' that says 'Stay curious'.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirmation that the template was created, with its ID and a link to open it in the Templated editor.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for AI image generation, since Templated only renders templates the user already designed.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a picture of a cat wearing sunglasses on a beach.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT handles this with its own image generation; the Templated app is not invoked.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for photo editing, which Templated does not do.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Remove the background from this photo and make it brighter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; Templated cannot edit an arbitrary photo, only render templates.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for publishing to social networks, which is outside the app's scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post this image to my Instagram account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; Templated has no tool to publish to social networks.
